title: miscompilation via engineered StableSourceFileId hash collisions
author: jsnell
body_preview: `rustc` uses the `Path` hash code to identify files, and the `Path` hash implementation is particularly weak because it ignores separators. As of PR #127297, it tries to compensate by mixing the component lengths into the hash, but it's still easy to manufacture collisions.
